descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S13 Custom template without a type cannot be saved; the type list is the 8 types plus Procedure / other (both contexts)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T3 Creating a custom template requires the mandatory type field (one of the 8 types, or Procedure/other). The type drives billing like a stock template (TFA-92596), and 'Procedure / other' gets no billi … (TFA-92599 AC 8; UAT TC-18) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Settings → Note Templates → New, in Hospital and in Nursing Home

When Fill name and instructions, leave the type empty and press Save Template; close the form and look at the list; open the type field

Then Save is refused (the form stays open) and the template is not in the list afterwards. The type options are the 8 pilot types plus Procedure / other, with no Clinic and no removed prototype templates. Billing per type is S24.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs. The template-list checkpoint (taken after closing the form) decides the refusal: mustNotContain the template name. The required-field message wording is recorded and calibrated on the first run with AC 8 merged. This is the same check as TC-18 S09; run one of them per account, not both.

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S13 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-21.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
